description.value: Punk Rock Pastries is a Burnaby bakery founded in 2019 by Chef Hollie Fraser, a three-time Food Network champion (The Big Bake Halloween, Bake Master Battle, Halloween Baking Championship), specializing in jaw-dropping 3D sculpted cakes, moving cakes, and unconventional pastries. The shop operates as a 100% nut-free facility and carries vegan and gluten-free options alongside its full menu of custom and walk-in treats, including its alter-ego line Peep Show Pastries for adult-themed events. After a temporary closure, the bakery has reopened at the same Hastings Street location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Punk Rock Pastries is an active specialty bakery at 5548 Hastings St, Burnaby, run by Food Network champion Chef Hollie Fraser. The About page explicitly states 'We did close down but now we are back and better than ever!' confirming current operation after a prior closure. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the website focuses entirely on custom cakes, pastries, and baking classes. The OSM-listed community of 'North Vancouver' conflicts with the website and postal code V5B 1R3, which place the business in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but postal code V5B 1R3 and all website content consistently identify the location as Burnaby — the community field in OSM appears to be incorrect.

OSM opening_hours (Mo-Fr 09:00-17:00; Sa 09:00-15:00; Su off) disagree with the website contact page (Tue-Fri 10am-5pm, Sat 9:30am-3:30pm, closed Sun-Mon) — website hours should be preferred and OSM hours should be updated.
Business previously closed and has since reopened ('We did close down but now we are back and better than ever!') — worth monitoring for stability.

Phone number (+1-604-423-4101) from OSM could not be explicitly confirmed from website text (site displays 'Call Us' without showing the number in scraped content); contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating food business with an active website and confirmed physical address; sells walk-in pastries, cupcakes, sausage rolls, and cookies that a touring cyclist could purchase as a food stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: Walk-in food items (pastries, cupcakes, sausage rolls, cookies) are available for same-day purchase alongside advance-order custom cakes, making it a viable snack stop for cyclists passing through Burnaby on Hastings Street.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag is shop=bakery; this is a specialty custom-cake and pastry bakery, not a grocery store. A category of 'Cafe & Bakery' or similar would be more accurate, but it does sell food items (pastries, cupcakes, sausage rolls, cookies) for walk-in purchase.
